alice.name: Alice Reader
alice.about: A researcher who sends two agents out: one on her laptop, one running in the cloud. Both should count as her.

bob.name: Bob Reader
bob.about: A colleague of Alice's. A different person, so a different allowance and unrelated identifiers everywhere.

carol.name: Carol Reader
carol.about: A procurement lead whose agent buys for work. Reads business pieces and pays without hesitation.

demo.name: Demo Reader
demo.about: A throwaway for live demos. Rename with a date suffix (demo-oct1) for a fresh monthly allowance.
